🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No automated tax assessments without HMRC officer review and approval
  • ❌ No taxpayer data sharing with commercial entities without explicit statutory authority
  • ❌ No algorithmic debt collection enforcement without human vulnerability assessment
  • ❌ No IR35 status determination overrides without documented CEST rationale
  • ❌ No cross-border data transfers without GDPR adequacy or appropriate safeguards
  • ❌ No fraud risk scoring used for criminal investigation without judicial oversight
